source_description: A surreal desert scene features a glowing purple figure on the left holding a golden halo and a large ornate mirror in the center. Inside the mirror, a blue-haired woman and a green-skinned figure kiss. To the right, a Grim Reaper-like figure in purple robes holds a sign reading 'Concede World'. A red phoenix flies across a stormy sky with a smiling moon and lightning.
source_prompt: Surreal desert landscape at night with dramatic stormy sky, large smiling crescent moon, lightning, and a flying red phoenix. In the center stands an ornate golden mirror reflecting a blue-haired woman passionately kissing a green-skinned figure. To the left, a glowing purple humanoid with a halo walks forward. To the right, a skeletal Grim Reaper in flowing purple robes holds a sign that says 'Concede World'. Scattered pills, potted flowers, and small blue ghost figures on the cracked ground. Mystical and symbolic atmosphere with dripping gold from the mirror frame.
